_help: Rules that hide systems a car doesn't have. A rule hides every menu entry for the listed cars whose title contains one of 'titles', when all 'hide_when' options match. Edit freely. 'Show all systems' in the app ignores these rules.

rules.why: Soft top and roll-over bars are convertible only
